title: A 4xx action that interrupts the revalidation of an earlier successful action leaves loader data stale
author: agcty
body_preview: ## What happens  Submission A succeeds and its loader revalidation starts. Before that revalidation commits, submission B is made and its action returns (or, for a navigation, throws) a 4xx/5xx response. B cancels A's in-flight revalidation, and then B's own revalidation is skipped because of the "do not revalidate after a 4xx/5xx action" default.
